description: Tribal Resilience Resource Guide is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by EPA Tribal Environmental Protection; DOE Office of Indian Energy Policy and Programs; USGS Climate Adaptation Science Centers. Tribal communities can use this guide to find resources related to resilience in a single format across agencies, regions, Tribes, and groups. The site offers a user manual, training videos, and a contact / feedback link for assistance or to suggest additions. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Air Quality, Changing Seasons, Erosion and Shoreline Recession, Flooding – Coastal, Landslides. Assets: Agriculture and Food Supply, Aquatic and Marine Resources, Cultural and Community Services, Natural Areas and Wildlife, People, Transportation and Mobility. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
